card.name: Numbers and comparison words in dose tables
card.fires_on: Digits and small words in the middle of numeric ranges, dose tables and comparisons (e.g. 'to 125', 'below 30%', 'the HLB decreases'). The setting is a place where a value or level is about to be stated.

modes.label: Table numbers
modes.description: Digits, decimal points or spaces inside stepped numeric ranges in dosing tables.

modes.label: Comparison words
modes.description: Small words such as below, low, average or the that lead into a level or amount.
modes.example: compared with 40% in the 27–34 age group and<< below>> 30% for women 3

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning highest, lowest or maximum, so it seems to steer away from extreme-value words.
card.plain: It fires on numbers in dose tables and on small words that lead into a level or amount.
